Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

In the sect's early nights, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu anarchs played an instrumental role in shaping the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, helping establish much of its structure and beliefs following the Convention of Thorns. Where their @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} kin are drawn to art and beauty, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} - sometimes called the Perverts - have become fascinated instead with pain and displeasure, their own or others'.

Disciplines: Auspex, Celerity, Presence

Advantage: Every Toreador begins with Academics, Crafts, Performance or Subterfuge — one Trait each of any two, or two Traits of one.

Disadvantage: When presented with a work of great art, a Toreador becomes absorbed in it, lost in a fugue state. They can only break free willingly by expending a Mental Trait, though injury or another distraction can also break the enthrallment.

Organization: Toreador antitribu remain influential voices within Sabbat leadership circles, drawing on their early role in founding the sect's structures and rites.
